sources: Exponential backoff and jitter, AWS Architecture Blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/architecture/exponential-backoff-and-jitter/

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Removing the check (with max_attempts=2 and Random(1)) adds a sleep after the final failed attempt: sleeps change from [0.4866] to [0.4866, 0.8305], so the caller waits a full backoff before RetriesExhausted surfaces. R1 forbids any sleep after the last attempt.

Replacing the jittered return with the bare capped value makes attempt-3 delay exactly 2.0 s for every client (computed: seeds 11/12/13 give 1.8190/1.8102/1.8964 with jitter, 2.0000 without), so concurrent clients retry in lockstep. R1 requires jitter.

Re-raising last_error directly changes the outcome: 4 failing attempts give TransientError('503') instead of RetriesExhausted('gave up after 4 attempts: 503') with attempts=4, so callers lose the attempt count and the type they catch. R2 requires RetriesExhausted.

Removing the guard lets RetryPolicy(max_attempts=0) construct; retry_call then raises RetriesExhausted('gave up after 0 attempts: None') with zero operation calls, instead of ValueError at construction. R3 requires the ValueError.

The explicit empty entry makes RELEASED terminal. Removing it makes can_transition and transition raise KeyError for a released lot (computed), instead of returning False and raising InvalidTransition. R4 requires both results.

Replacing the copy with self.items aliases the list: after a transition and items.append('S2'), history[0].items_snapshot changes from ['S1'] to ['S1', 'S2'] (computed). R5 requires the stored entry to stay unchanged.

The identity test keeps an explicit 0. Replacing it with submitted-or-default maps an explicit 0 to 50 (computed: effective_quantity(0, 50) returns 0 here, 'submitted or 50' returns 50), which breaks R6 for an empty container. None and 7 give the same result in both forms.
Removing the bool test lets True through as one unit: effective_quantity(True, 5) returns True instead of raising ValidationError('quantity must be an integer'). R6 rejects boolean values.

Sample codes follow R8 (lower case, no hyphens) and lot codes follow R7 (upper-cased first). A merged normaliser that lower-cases input and applies this pattern accepts 'ABCDEFGH' as 'abcdefgh' (computed: True), which R8 rejects. The dedicated check rejects it (computed).

Unchanged line: copy_utils.py is not in change.diff, so a diff-mode reviewer must not report it. Real flaw outside spec.md: chunk([1, 2, 3], -2) returns [] and silently drops all items (computed). A list-comprehension rewrite keeps the same range call, so the flaw is not something simplification would change.
